item.title: [AAPL] TSMC posts 58% quarterly profit jump, beating market expectations
item.description: TSMC, the world's main producer of advanced AI chips and a major supplier to ‌Nvidia, on Thursday posted a 58% jump in first-quarter profit to record ‌levels that handily beat market forecasts.
